_source: RFIRE.BIN: the MAN object descriptor 0x44eb38 and its behaviours 0x434460 / 0x434350 / 0x433d40 / 0x433d80 / 0x434220 / 0x434320 / 0x4345d0, the tick 0x433ab0, the init 0x433a50, the constants at 0x44ea90 (speed 0x44ea9c, idle distance 0x1000000, throw window 0x400000..0x600000), the grenade-count table 0x44eab0, the separation offsets 0x44ead8, the draw descriptor 0x44e928 (callback 0x433950, corners 0x44e448, part blocks 0x44e4a8 / 0x44e6a8) and its shape 0x44e8e8; issue #74, wiki documents 113 and 116. Angles: 0x400000 = 360 degrees; 16.16 values divided by 65536. The building table (`buildings`) is derived by the importers from the coastal table's field [3] (`flags` in coastal_damage.json): bits 16-19 min, 20-23 max, 0x8000 flips the team, and only entries with at least 2 hit points qualify (a hit must leave exactly 1).
